definition.name: Build three affected products and check normal configuration and provenance

steps.name: Fetch the immutable original four-product compiler source
Install existing pinned Python recipe dependencies
Build only the three affected products and retain exact source and controls
steps.run:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import os, shutil, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from tools import build_process_linux, build_process_signals
from tools.build_observation import build_environment
from tools import c_thread_package_native_products as inherited
inherited_revision=inherited.SOURCE
from tools.java_replay_materials import git_source_identity
from tools.phase2_operator_process import require
from tools.phase3_resource_identity import file_identity, source_identity
from tools.rust_capsule_build import Commands
from tools.rust_capsule_project import fresh, write_json
root=Path.cwd();output=fresh(Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])/'c-thread-admission-native')
revision=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,timeout=10).decode().strip()
changed=('apps/latentd/src/config/derive.rs','apps/latentd/src/config/policy.rs',
    'apps/latentd/src/config/tests/providers/activation_runtime.rs',
    'crates/latent-signing/src/provenance/tests.rs','crates/latent-signing/src/provenance/validate.rs')
original=git_source_identity(inherited_revision)
require(original['sha256']=='sha256:598ed59a0797ac24c006fe47162d74672b7a603669192e7019a83eced0a98d14'
    and original['files']==3325 and original['bytes']==26393594,'c-admission-inherited-original-native-source')
before=source_identity(root)
require(before==git_source_identity(revision),'c-admission-current-git-native-source')
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',inherited_revision,revision,'--',
    'apps','crates','sdk/rust','tools/optimization-workloads','Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock',
    'rust-toolchain.toml','.cargo/config.toml'],cwd=root,timeout=15).decode().splitlines()
require(paths==list(changed),'c-admission-only-reviewed-five-native-input-changes')
changes={}
for name in changed:
    raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',inherited_revision+':'+name],cwd=root,timeout=15)
    require(len(raw)<=64*1024,'c-admission-original-source-bound')
    from tools.rust_capsule_project import digest
    changes[name]={'inherited':{'sha256':digest(raw),'bytes':len(raw)},'compiled':file_identity(root/name)}
def helpers():
    result={'.github/workflows/c-thread-admission-native.yml':file_identity(root/'.github/workflows/c-thread-admission-native.yml')}
    for module in tuple(sys.modules.values()):
        filename=getattr(module,'__file__',None)
        if type(filename) is str:
            path=Path(filename).resolve()
            if path.suffix=='.py' and path.is_relative_to(root):result[path.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=file_identity(path)
    require(0<len(result)<=256 and sum(row['bytes'] for row in result.values())<=4*1024**2,
        'c-admission-producer-helper-closure-bound')
    return dict(sorted(result.items()))
original_materials=inherited.READER._git_materials()
require(len(original_materials)==134 and all(file_identity(root/name)==row for name,row in original_materials.items()),
    'c-admission-original-full-auxiliary-inputs-current')
def materials_now():
    return dict(sorted({**{name:file_identity(root/name) for name in original_materials},**helpers()}.items()))
materials=materials_now()
write_json(output/'source-inputs.json',{'native':before,'inheritedNativeSource':original,
    'inheritedRevision':inherited_revision,'reviewedNativeChanges':changes,
    'allOtherNativeFilesByteExact':3320,'materials':materials})
target=Path(os.environ.get('CARGO_TARGET_DIR',root/'target')).resolve()
environment=build_environment(output)
environment.update(CARGO_TARGET_DIR=str(target),RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.97.1',CARGO_INCREMENTAL='0',
    CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG='0',CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG='0',CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS='true',
    CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG_ASSERTIONS='true',CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_OVERFLOW_CHECKS='true',
    CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_OVERFLOW_CHECKS='true')
started=time.monotonic()
commands=Commands(root,output,environment,deadline_seconds=1320,command_seconds=1200)
record={'schemaVersion':'latent.sdk.native-product-overlay.v1','sourceRevision':revision,
    'nativeSource':before,'materials':materials,'profile':'normal-managed-guest-default-features',
    'inheritedProducts':{'sourceRevision':inherited_revision,'nativeSource':original,
        'keys':['examples/package','examples/capsule_contracts']},
    'productsBuilt':['latent','latentd','examples/capsule_authoring'],'signedQualification':False,'guestCompiled':False,'backendCompiled':False}
try:
    compiler=commands.run('rust-version','rustc','--version').decode().strip()
    require(compiler.startswith('rustc 1.97.1 ('),'c-admission-exact-rust-version')
    commands.run('normal-affected-products-build','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
        'build','--locked','-p','latent','-p','latentd','--bins','-p','latent-policy','--example','capsule_authoring')
    products={};owned=output/'native-binaries';owned.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    for name in ('latent','latentd','examples/capsule_authoring'):
        source=target/'debug'/name;destination=owned/name.replace('/','-')
        identity=file_identity(source,512*1024**2);shutil.copyfile(source,destination);destination.chmod(0o700)
        require(identity==file_identity(source,512*1024**2)==file_identity(destination,512*1024**2),
            'c-admission-product-capture-unchanged')
        with destination.open('rb') as stream:require(stream.read(4)==b'\x7fELF','c-admission-real-ELF-product')
        products[name]=identity
    record['builtProductIdentities']=products
    record['focusedControlsPassed']=False
    result=commands.run('normal-activation-configuration-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
        'test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib','config::tests::providers::activation_runtime::','--','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 8 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-admission-exact-eight-runtime-config-controls')
    for stage,name in (
        ('closed-c-engine','config::tests::engine::c_threading_engine_input_is_closed_and_default_input_remains_unselected'),
        ('closed-root-only','config::tests::engine::activation_stack_accounting_is_a_closed_opt_in_and_omission_stays_default'),
        ('normal-defaults','config::tests::defaults_derive_compatible_node_limits_without_creating_storage')):
        result=commands.run(stage,'cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
            'test','--locked','-p','latentd','--lib',name,'--','--exact','--test-threads=1')
        require(b'test result: ok. 1 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-admission-exact-single-control')
    result=commands.run('go-provenance-profile-controls','cargo','--config',root/'.cargo/managed-guest.toml',
        'test','--locked','-p','latent-signing','--lib','provenance::tests::','--','--test-threads=1')
    require(b'test result: ok. 3 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' in result,'c-admission-exact-three-provenance-controls')
    record.update(status='passed',focusedControlsPassed=True,compiler=compiler,commands=commands.records,
        products=products,
        nativeSourceAfter=source_identity(root),materialsAfter=materials_now(),
        elapsedSeconds=time.monotonic()-started)
    require(record['nativeSourceAfter']==before and record['materialsAfter']==materials,
        'c-admission-final-full-source-and-materials')
    write_json(output/'native-products.json',record)
except BaseException:
    record.update(status='failed',commands=commands.records)
    write_json(output/'FAILED.json',record)
    raise
PY
